description: This is a Java unit test file for KafkaClientActor in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.kafka package. It tests connection management, message publishing, and connection metrics retrieval for Kafka client actors using Akka test probes and mock servers.

classes.name: KafkaClientActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of KafkaClientActor including connection handling, message publishing, and connection metrics retrieval.

classes.name: MockKafkaPublisherActor
classes.description: A mock actor class simulating Kafka publisher behavior, used for testing message flow and actor interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before all tests, including creating actor system and starting mock server.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment after all tests, shutting down the actor system and stopping the mock server.

methods.name: initializeConnection
methods.description: Prepares a new connection instance for each test.

methods.name: testConnect
methods.description: Tests the connection and disconnection process of KafkaClientActor.

methods.name: testPublishToTopic
methods.description: Verifies message publishing functionality to a Kafka topic.

methods.name: testTestConnectionFails
methods.description: Ensures proper handling of failed connection attempts.

methods.name: getKafkaClientActorProps
methods.description: Utility method to create Props for KafkaClientActor with test configurations.
